item.title: After another lapse in coverage, trade groups urge Congress to pass long-term NFIP bill
item.description: Housing trade groups urged Congress to reauthorize the NFIP, highlighting its importance for millions of homeowners facing flood risks.

item.title: Buyer owes $24K after breaching buyers broker agreement, arbitration finds
item.description: Arbitration awarded $24,000 to a brokerage after a buyer breached an exclusive broker agreement under new NAR rules.

item.title: MBA voices support for proposed cut to community banks’ leverage ratio
item.description: Federal regulators propose lowering the CBLR to 8% and extending compliance grace periods for community banks.

item.title: ROAD to Housing Act dropped from NDAA, sparking trade group response
item.description: The ROAD to Housing Act was left out of the 2026 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) in the final House text released on Sunday.

item.title: Sweeping new zoning targets Nashville housing affordability
item.description: Nashville’s new zoning laws enable townhomes, triplexes and accessory units to expand housing options and affordability citywide.

item.title: House committee is set to review Senate-approved housing bill
item.description: The ROAD to Housing Act was not included in the NDAA, but bipartisan support remains strong. The House will review the bill later this month.

item.title: NRMLA speaks out on the future of federal reverse mortgage programs
item.description: After federal housing leaders issued a request for information in October about the future of two key reverse mortgage programs, the National Reverse Mortgage Lenders Association (NRMLA) weighed in last week with a detailed list of suggestions.

item.title: Glut of new supply drags down BTR and multifamily rental rates in the Sun Belt
item.description: Rents for multifamily and built-to-rent homes declined in Sunbelt markets amid new supply, but Midwest and Northeast cities saw growth. National occupancy remained steady.

item.title: Optimal Blue announces new CFO and CRO
item.description: Optimal Blue promotes Lanny Rogers III to chief financial officer and Jeremy Moreno to chief revenue officer, signaling strategic growth.

item.title: Summit Sotheby’s International Realty rides high in Utah while giving back
item.description: The agency has donated $2.3 million to Utah nonprofits supporting education, food security, mental health, first responders and more.
